risk_note: RV1 (agent orchestrator). C-32 (D10-1469; BR-AI-06 细则 line 322: suggestions from the model must pass OutputGuard): a search term from the model's tool call is checked before it fills {q_short} of agent.suggest.no_result.2 — the whole q_short (first 8 code points) is run once through the guard's filter rules (amount, link / token / short link) and, with no hit, the run's own review port (timeout retried once like the guard; still not passing → no suggestion 2); a hit or a review block leaves out suggestion 2, keeps 1 and 3, and merges output_filtered / filter_hits into the run's trace. The check is a separate per-run query checker and never touches the run's own explanation guard (no sentence buffer, no two-sentence budget). The source travels with the chain id: a chain opened by a model call gets a 'model-' prefixed id, and every server continuation (refine, next batch, platform, price change, price answer, withoutCondition, cheaper) keeps base.chain_id, so the flag follows and cannot be forged by the model; keyword chains (server's own term) are unchanged. Not stored in conditions because frozen tests compare conditions exactly. Codex general r1 pass with one S2 (a multi-sentence term like 茶。杯。好。9元 slipped past the guard's two-sentence cut) fixed in round 2 (whole q_short checked at once, unit tests pin it); r2 incremental pass. Out of scope, logged for later: review-timeout fail-close pinned by rule tests; banned words in the OutputGuard. Rule tests by Codex (2 attempts), independent Claude spec-test r1 fail → r2 pass. Test machine: red/2 PASS (15 tests) at the spec commit; verify:fast green twice (D10-1503); full verification is the required CI checks (approvals #21).
